FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Wipro announces results for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026
IT services segment revenue flat sequentially and increased 0.6% YoY CC
Operating Margin at 16.5% expanded 0.5% QoQ
EPS increased 4.2% YoY; Operating cash flow at 165.8% of Net income
EAST BRUNSWICK, N.J. | BENGALURU, India – October 15, 2026 : Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO), a
leading AI-powered technology services and consulting company, announced financial results under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Highlights of the Results
Results for the
Quarter ended September 30, 2026:
1. |
Gross revenue at
₹ 247.5 billion ($2,583.0 million 1 ), an increase of 1.1% QoQ and 9.1% YoY.
2. |
IT services segment revenue was at $2611.5 million, decrease of 0.1% QoQ and increase of 0.3% YoY.
3. |
Non-GAAP constant
currency 2 IT Services segment revenue was flat sequentially and increase of 0.6% YoY.
4. |
Total Bookings 3 was at $2,595 million, down by 22.9%
QoQ in constant currency 2 . Large deal bookings 4 was at $674 million, decrease of 58.6% QoQ in constant currency 2 .
5. |
IT services operating margin 5 for Q2’27 was at
16.5%, up by 0.5% QoQ and down by 0.2% YoY.
6. |
Net income for the quarter was at
₹ 32.0 billion ($333.9 million 1 ), decrease of 4.7% QoQ and 1.9% YoY.
7. |
Earnings per share for the quarter at
₹ 3.23 ($0.03 1 ), increase of 0.9% QoQ and increase of 4.2% YoY.
8. |
Operating cash flows of
₹ 53.0 billion ($553.6 million 1 ), increase of 61.3% QoQ and at 165.8% of net income for the quarter.
9. |
Voluntary attrition was at 13.8% on a trailing 12-month basis.
Outlook for the Quarter ending December 31, 2026
We expect revenue from our IT Services business segment to be in the range of $2,571 million to $2,625 million*. This translates to sequential guidance of
(-)1.5% to (+)0.5% in constant currency terms.
* |
Outlook for the Quarter ending December 31, 2026, is based on the following exchange rates: GBP/USD at
1.35, Euro/USD at 1.15 , AUD/USD at 0.71, USD/INR at 95.76 and CAD/USD at 0.72
1
Performance for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026
Srini Pallia, CEO and Managing Director, said, “The strategic investments we have been making are beginning to deliver results. They are
enhancing our ability to win in new markets, add new clients, and grow existing relationships. At the same time, our consulting-led, AI-powered strategy is helping us
create larger transformation opportunities. We see AI as a long-term growth driver that will expand the addressable market for technology and business transformation. We are already seeing its potential reflected in the momentum across our AI-Native Unit and AI offerings portfolio”.
Aparna Iyer, Chief Financial Officer, said, “ Our
operating margin for the quarter was 16.5%, an expansion of 0.5% sequentially. We have delivered this improvement even while continuing to invest in our business and people. We remain relentless in driving cash flow conversion. Q2 is yet another
quarter where our operating cash flow has been robust and stood at 166% of net income.”
1. |

Highlights of Strategic Deal Wins
In Q2’27, Wipro continued to win large and strategic deals across industries. Key highlights include:
1. |
One of the largest US-based banking institutions has selected Wipro to
modernize its mortgage operations through Wipro’s lending platform NetOxygen. Powered by Wipro Intelligence ™ , the platform will be implemented to simplify lending processes, automate
key tasks, and provide actionable insights to support faster and more informed decision-making. Deployment of this platform is expected to improve borrower experience, accelerate loan closing times, and create a more efficient, scalable, and
compliant lending ecosystem.
2. |
A global technology company has renewed and expanded its relationship with Wipro to modernize its Enterprise
Products organization and enhance employee experience through more resilient and scalable applications. As part of this multi-year engagement, Wipro will strengthen the client’s application landscape, support the development of AI-enabled enterprise solutions, and consolidate responsibilities into a unified delivery model. Wipro will leverage intelligent automation and AI-powered engineering
capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate testing and delivery, and create a more integrated, cost-efficient operating model that enhances application reliability and user experience.
2
3. |
Seeking to improve operational efficiency and overall stakeholder experience, a leading US-based health insurance provider has appointed Wipro as a strategic partner to transform its provider services organization. Wipro will combine
end-to-end provider support services with analytics, workforce planning, quality management, and operational excellence methodologies to identify root causes, optimize
workflows, and improve business outcomes. This engagement will help accelerate issue resolution, enhance customer experience, and create a more scalable and cost-efficient operating model.
4. |
Wipro was selected by a global biotechnology company to transform and scale its post-market quality assurance
operations to address changing regulatory requirements and the need for greater operational efficiency. Wipro will deliver end-to-end complaint management, reporting,
and multilingual support services. Wipro will also introduce an AI-enabled operating model to ensure intelligent document processing, workflow orchestration, and automated compliance support. This
transformation will improve processing speed, quality, and audit readiness, while reducing costs and creating a more resilient organization.
5. |
A leading Asia-based Fortune 500 conglomerate selected Wipro to establish an AI Global Capability Center (GCC)
as part of its enterprise AI transformation agenda. The engagement combines AI engineering talent, governance, innovation programs, and capability building to accelerate the development of AI-powered products
and platforms while creating a scalable operating model for long-term growth.
6. |
A leading global network technology provider has selected Wipro for a strategic engagement to scale its core
mobile network services business worldwide. Wipro will provide network implementation, testing, and AI-led automation to simplify delivery and improve operational efficiency. The engagement will enable the
client to expand delivery capacity, accelerate service deployment, and enhance quality and consistency across customer programs through a centralized delivery model.
7. |
In a significant win for Wipro’s AI-Native Business &
Platform unit, a large North American public services organization has selected Wipro to modernize its enrolment, customer engagement, and operational management processes. Wipro will deploy an AI-native
digital operations platform designed to streamline onboarding, communications, and workflow management through a unified operating model. Powered by AI agents, conversational AI, intelligent document processing and predictive analytics, the platform
will automate complex processes, enhance operational efficiency, and improve user experiences at scale. This win further demonstrates growing demand for AI-native platforms that help organizations simplify
operations, improve service outcomes, and accelerate digital transformation.
8. |
A global leader in beverages has awarded Wipro an expanded engagement to simplify, consolidate and optimize its
technology operations. Wipro will deliver end-to-end infrastructure and hybrid cloud services, enhanced with Wipro Intelligence ™ , to provide personalized support, proactive issue resolution, automation of routine tasks, and improved operational visibility. The engagement will enhance employee experience, improve service
performance, strengthen compliance, and cost optimization.
9. |
A Europe-based global provider of industrial products and service solutions has renewed its engagement with
Wipro for an enterprise-wide business transformation. Wipro will implement a single global enterprise resource planning platform, standardizing processes and data across regions while modernizing the client’s core business systems. The program
will provide real-time operational and financial visibility, improve efficiency, and enhance the agility needed to scale and respond more quickly to evolving market and customer demands.
3
10. |
A leading global life sciences company has selected Wipro to establish an
AI-powered supply chain intelligence platform to improve the speed, consistency, and quality of critical decisions. Beginning with a consulting-led assessment of
business processes, data readiness, and governance requirements, Wipro will establish a trusted data foundation and deploy agents through WEGA to improve manufacturing, distribution, and inventory management decisions. This engagement will help
accelerate decision-making, strengthen supplier risk visibility, improve responsiveness to supply disruptions, and create a scalable platform for future growth.
11. |
A major energy company in the Middle East has selected Wipro to transform its procurement and finance
operations through an AI-led operating model. Leveraging Wipro Intelligence ™ , Wipro will automate procurement workflows, supplier interactions, invoice
management, and exception resolution. This will enable a more efficient, scalable and insight-driven enterprise operations function.
12. |
A leading North American financial services institution is modernizing its trade exception management
capability with Capco, a Wipro company, to create a single view of trade, settlement, and position exceptions across the enterprise. Capco will design and implement a scalable platform that consolidates data from multiple internal and external
sources, enabling faster investigation and resolution of operational exceptions. The solution will introduce AI-assisted exception detection, enhanced auditability, and configurable workflows to strengthen
accountability, and operational controls.

About Key Metrics and Non-GAAP Financial Measures
This press release contains key metrics and non-GAAP financial measures within the meaning of Regulation G and Item
10(e) of Regulation S-K. Such non-GAAP financial measures are measures of our historical or future performance, financial position or cash flows that are adjusted to
exclude or include amounts that are excluded or included, as the case may be, from the most directly comparable financial measure calculated and presented in accordance with IFRS.
The table on page 11 provides IT Services Revenue on a constant currency basis, which is a non-GAAP financial measure
that is calculated by translating IT Services Revenue from the current reporting period into U.S. dollars based on the currency conversion rate in effect for the prior reporting period. We refer to growth rates in constant currency so that business
results may be viewed without the impact of fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates, thereby facilitating period-to-period comparisons of our business
performance. Further, in the normal course of business, we may divest a portion of our business which may not be strategic. We refer to the growth rates in both reported and constant currency adjusting for such divestments in order to represent the
comparable growth rates.
Our key metrics and non-GAAP financial measures are not based on any comprehensive set
of accounting rules or principles and should not be considered a substitute for, or superior to, the most directly comparable financial measure calculated in accordance with IFRS and may be different from
non-GAAP measures used by other companies. Our key metrics and non-GAAP financial measures are not comparable to, nor should be substituted for, an analysis of our
revenue over time and involve estimates and judgments. In addition to our non-GAAP measures, the financial statements prepared in accordance with IFRS and the reconciliation of these non-GAAP financial measures with the most directly comparable IFRS financial measure should be carefully evaluated.
Results for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026, prepared under IFRS, along with individual business segment reports, are available in
the Investors section of our website www.wipro.com/investors/

About Wipro Limited
Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading AI-powered technology services and consulting
company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our consulting-led approach and the Wipro Intelligence ™ unified suite of AI-powered platforms, solutions and transformative offerings, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions to build intelligent and
sustainable businesses. The Wipro Innovation Network – part of the Wipro Intelligence ™ suite – underpins our commitment to client-centric
co-innovation and co-creation by bringing together capabilities from the innovation labs and partner labs, academia, and global tech communities. With over 230,000
employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com .
